references.text: Psalm 6:5 warns against falsehood in prayer, which is similar to Jesus' warning against hypocrisy in prayer in Matthew 6:5.
Isaiah 29:13 speaks of how people honor God with their lips while their hearts are far from Him, reflecting hypocrisy in prayer.
Matthew 23:14 criticizes the scribes and Pharisees for their hypocrisy, which aligns with the warning in Matthew 6:5.
Luke 18:10-14 tells the parable of the Pharisee and the tax collector, illustrating the right and wrong ways to pray, consistent with the principles in Matthew 6:5.
Matthew 6:16-18 also warns against hypocrisy, but in connection with fasting, showing a broader theme of inner sincerity in religious practice.
